claim.text: RoPE rotates each absolute position, and the attention score depends only on the relative distance between the tokens.

spec.explain: Toy dial illustration of arXiv 2104.09864: two rotating pointers for absolute positions m and n. Watch the relative-angle readout, which depends only on the distance m-n, not on absolute position.

questions.q: Predict what happens to rel_angle if m = 10 while n stays fixed?
questions.why: Tests that raising query position increases relative rotation.

questions.q: What is rel_dist when m = 8 and n = 3?
How does rel_angle change if theta = 0.9 with m and n fixed?
questions.why: Tests frequency scaling of the rotation.

questions.q: What happens to rel_dist if n = 12 while m stays at 6?
questions.why: Tests sign flip when key passes query.

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var m = state.m; var n = state.n; var th = state.theta; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var cx1 = w * 0.27; var cx2 = w * 0.73; var cy = h * 0.46; var r = 80; var k = 0; var a = 0; var tx = 0; var ty = 0; var am = m * th; var an = n * th; var rel = m - n; var rela = rel * th; ctx.strokeStyle = "#333333"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeStyle = "#999999"; for (k = 0; k < 12; k = k + 1) { a = k * Math.PI / 6; tx = Math.cos(a) * r; ty = Math.sin(a) * r; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx1 + tx * 0.9, cy + ty * 0.9); ctx.lineTo(cx1 + tx, cy + ty); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2 + tx * 0.9, cy + ty * 0.9); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + tx, cy + ty); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#bbbbbb"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx1, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx1 + r, cy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + r, cy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx1, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx1 + Math.cos(am) * r, cy - Math.sin(am) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#b03a2e"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + Math.cos(an) * r, cy - Math.sin(an) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1 + Math.cos(am) * r, cy - Math.sin(am) * r, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#b03a2e"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2 + Math.cos(an) * r, cy - Math.sin(an) * r, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#222222"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText("m = " + fmt(m), cx1, cy + r + 24); ctx.fillText("n = " + fmt(n), cx2, cy + r + 24); ctx.fillText("query dial m", cx1, cy - r - 14); ctx.fillText("key dial n", cx2, cy - r - 14); ctx.font = "15px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("rel_dist = " + fmt(rel), w * 0.5, h * 0.86); ctx.fillText("rel_angle = " + fmt(rela), w * 0.5, h * 0.93); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("not to scale", 12, 20); ctx.fillText("theta = " + fmt(th), 12, 38); }
